scope: Design self-review of eight original figures from seven papers. Original figure pixels were viewed in the browser, together with captions. This is not scientific replication, an impact-factor ranking or universal aesthetic acceptance.

sources.title: Human skin fibroblast single-cell and spatial atlas
sources.adopt: One primary embedding, persistent identity colours, marker blocks labelled by identity, wide cross-population evidence lane.
sources.reject: Do not reproduce tiny marker labels or put every subgroup feature map in the overview. Split detailed reading pages.
sources.implementation: figure_annotation_views: labelled marker assignments and separate evidence-first subgroup compositions

sources.title: Cell-type-specific nuclear compartments from spatial multi-omics
sources.adopt: Overview to explicitly selected region to orthogonal quantitative support; align physical coordinate tracks and retain modality-specific units.
sources.reject: No invented image evidence or inferred registration. A cell count is not a biological replicate count. Dense image and track detail needs a separate page.
sources.implementation: Selection guidance retained; existing frozen-coordinate spatial and track renderers reused, no registration or imaging engine executed

sources.title: Nicheformer single-cell and spatial omics foundation model
sources.adopt: Rows follow a question; relate attention summaries to spatial context and selected effects. Align related matrices and make their separate ranges explicit.
sources.reject: Avoid neon identity colours and repeated panels with no additional question. The paper's red/blue gene classes must not be mistaken for up/down regulation.
sources.implementation: Selection guidance; no attention model executed and no inference copied

sources.title: Scalable single-cell total RNA sequencing
sources.adopt: Named continuous ordering, stable state colours, selected-gene facets and enrichment summary with explicit member support.
sources.reject: Do not compare per-gene 0–1 values as absolute expression. No LOWESS or new scoring is fitted for styling. Reject crowded gene-program labels and significance-star piles.
sources.implementation: Aligned pathway rows, explicit membership tiles and contrast-specific gene-effect labels in figure_enrichment_story

sources.title: Genome-wide fine-mapping calibration
sources.adopt: Equal x/y ranges and a visible identity reference; rows indicate scenarios and columns comparison families.
sources.reject: Avoid red/green-only contrasts and repeated small legends. Do not label these PIP calibration simulations as clinical-risk calibration.
sources.implementation: Selection guidance for supplied calibration tables; no fine-mapping engine executed

sources.title: COMPASS clinical-cohort evaluation
sources.adopt: Keep cohort design visible beside held-out evaluation. Encode opposing transfer counts around a common baseline and identify comparator/reference results.
sources.reject: Do not default to dozens of narrow bars with vertical method names, rainbow cohort annotations or plots that confuse patient, cohort and training-seed replication.
sources.implementation: Selection guidance: prefer horizontal estimates or a comparison matrix when method names are long

sources.title: COMPASS survival and tumour-immune profiles
sources.adopt: Show survival uncertainty and effect intervals, preserve state labels across profiles, and group concepts by biological role.
sources.reject: Do not copy dense 16-axis radar layouts or rainbow continuous scales. Supply risk counts when available and check group labels against actual data. Polygon area is not an effect size.
sources.implementation: Selection guidance: radar remains optional; aligned dot profiles or matrices are preferable for precise many-feature comparisons

sources.title: GBP2 module, enrichment and spatial evidence
sources.adopt: Relate supplied module identities to module-trait estimates, enrichment and independent candidate support. Use the correct HR null and preserve the full source scope.
sources.reject: The crowded nine-part page and tiny spatial legends are unsuitable defaults. Retain full GSEA running score, hit positions and ranked metric when supplied; an enrichment curve alone is insufficient. One section is not replicated tissue evidence.
sources.implementation: Reuse WGCNA/hdWGCNA and full GSEA renderers; no module detection, Cox model or spatial analysis executed
